people.name: Gavrilo Princip
people.extract: Gavrilo Princip was a Bosnian Serb student who assassinated Archduke Franz Ferdinand, heir presumptive to the throne of Austria-Hungary, and his wife Sophie, Duchess of Hohenberg, in Sarajevo on 28 June 1914. The assassination set off the July Crisis, a series of events that within one month led to the outbreak of World War I.
highlights: His assassination led to the outbreak of World War I.

people.name: Jerry Paris
people.extract: William Gerald Paris was an American actor and director best known for playing Jerry Helper, the dentist and next-door neighbor of Rob and Laura Petrie on The Dick Van Dyke Show, and for directing the majority of the episodes of the sitcom Happy Days.
highlights: Played Jerry Helper on The Dick Van Dyke Show.
Directed majority of episodes of Happy Days.
